en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 98.37 per cent by 5pm
en.dek: Official figures show 5,616 of 5,709 eligible electors have voted as of 5pm on Sunday, with polls set to close at 6pm.
body: The Registration and Electoral Office said cumulative voter turnout in the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections reached 98.37 per cent by 5pm on Sunday, with 5,616 electors having cast ballots out of 5,709 eligible.

Polling stations opened at 9am and are scheduled to close at 6pm. Several subsectors have already recorded full turnout, continuing the high participation seen through the day that has exceeded the final rate of the previous election.

Electoral Affairs Commission officials have described the process as orderly. Results are expected to be announced after ballot boxes are transported to the central counting station at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午5時投票率98.37%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午5時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5616人投票，累積投票率達98.37%，投票站將於下午6時結束。
body: 選舉事務處表示，選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉截至周日下午5時，累積投票率達98.37%，5709名合資格投票人中已有5616人投票。
投票站上午9時開放，下午6時結束。多個界別分組已達百分百投票率，全日投票率持續高於上屆最終數字。
選舉管理委員會官員形容過程有序。票箱將運送至香港會議展覽中心中央點票站，結果待點票完成後公布。
